images.title: Ask everyone, write a list
images.purpose: Show that we ask every classmate the same question and write the answers down in a list.
images.composition: A column of child markers on the left, one arrow in the middle, one blank list on the right, with wide space between them.
images.exact_structure: Left: a vertical column of exactly 5 equal teal #0072B2 circles, evenly spaced, each a plain classmate marker with no face. Middle: one grey #6B7280 arrow pointing right. Right: one white list sheet with exactly 5 equal ruled lines, each line holding one small amber #E69F00 dot. Exactly 5 circles, 5 lines, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
circles that differ in size, or a list with a different number of lines than circles
images.takeaway: Ask every classmate the same question and write the answers in a list.
images.description: Five classmate circles with an arrow to a list sheet with five lines, each holding one answer dot.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say who must be asked and where the answers go.

image_decisions.why: Collecting answers from everyone into a list is a picture idea; one image carries it.
